notes.title: Twin Trials — a fast-paced arcade FPS, launching July 31st!
notes.content: [h3][b]🔥 Get ready for a pure adrenaline rush![/b][/h3][p][i]Twin Trials[/i] throws you into a time-trial gauntlet where precision is king and speed rules all. Glide, rocket-jump, shoot, die, and blast your way to the top — do you have what it takes to dominate the global leaderboards?[/p][previewyoutube="jNJf4hmR4bc;full"][/previewyoutube]
